title: Crumple
description: A real film photo print, Kodak's sun hats on a wall, lying on the table. Each press crushes it one step further: the first squeeze already breaks it into sharp creases and flat facets, each later one folds it tighter until it is a faceted ball under the lamp. Keep pressing and it opens back out a step at a time, keeping every crease.
intent: Realistic paper in discrete stages: a cloth simulation with plastic bending is baked offline, and every stage sits on the creased fold path with flat-shaded facets, so the sheet folds along sharp ridges from the first press and never puffs up like a bag; each press springs it quickly to the next stage and lets it settle.
sources: Print photo: kodim03 (hats), a 35mm film scan from Kodak Photo CD PCD0992, released by the Eastman Kodak Company for unrestricted usage; via https://github.com/MohamedBakrAli/Kodak-Lossless-True-Color-Image-Suite (mirror of http://r0k.us/graphics/kodak/), cropped square and re-encoded as webp.
